cards.name: Merciful Sacrament
cards.effect: Merciful Sacrament. Tags: saint, sacrament. When you start Sacrament and at least one living ally inside its initial zone is at or below one-quarter maximum HP, you may reduce that Sacrament's Conviction cost to 0. Its RP cost and all other requirements remain. Because no Conviction is spent, this waived cost does not vent Dissonance.

source.originalText: Merciful Sacrament: Sacraments cost no Conviction if used on an ally under 25% HP.

engineReferences.text: Cleric techniques use only their printed RP and Conviction costs. All RP is paid from the Cleric's Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. A Cleric technique is not automatically an ordinary spell-rank cast and does not receive Overcast, spell-slot, cost-discount or spell-proc benefits unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. Ordinary spells continue to use Core V 2 spellcasting rules.

cards.name: Spell Efficiency
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Spell Efficiency. Tags: arcanist, resonance, focus. After you legally cast a Focus-eligible spell, your next differently named Focus-eligible spell of the same current element before the end of your next regular turn costs 1 less RP, minimum 1 RP. This reduction cannot apply to Focus finishers, Resonance Surge's additional cost or a spell already reduced to 0 by another explicit feature.

source.originalText: Spell Efficiency: Reduce the Resonance Point cost of spells cast in sequence with the same element.

cards.name: Spell Sharing
cards.cost: 4 RP plus the shared card's printed RP cost
cards.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
cards.effect: Spell Sharing. Tags: archmage, spell-sharing. Choose one Base or Arch Mage spell card you know with an Action activation and printed base RP cost 4 or less. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that card once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your Mage spell attack and DC. It cannot share summons, Counterspell, Hero cards, finishers, Resonance Surge or another Spell Sharing.

source.originalText: Spell Sharing: Temporarily grant an ally access to one of your spells.

cards.name: Resonance Apex — NEW Playtest Capstone
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
cards.effect: Before paying for one Mage spell, reduce that spell's printed RP cost by up to 10 RP, minimum final cost 0. This capstone is new playtest design and is not claimed as a recovered historical feature. The cast cannot also use Resonance Surge or generic Overcast. It remains one spell cast, follows ordinary Focus/Nuke Chain rules, and alters Dissonance only through rules that would already apply to that cast.

cards.name: Sacred Echo Slot
cards.effect: Add one slot usable only for Mend or Ward, total storage cap 6. If already at 6, designate one existing slot sacred instead; once/short rest its release costs 1 less RP, minimum 1. No duplicate slot or free record.

source.originalText: Sacred Echo Slot: +1 additional slot for healing/support abilities.

cards.name: Elder Spirit Accord — new Hero capstone
cards.effect: When starting Elemental Chorus, Omen Loop or Bloodroot Trail, reduce its RP cost by 3, minimum 1, and add M to one damage/healing roll from that use. You must know that ability and still spend its own limited use. If you do not know it, instead reduce one known Hero technique's RP cost by 3, minimum 1. No extra duration, flask, totem, command or repeated cast.

cards.name: Spell Efficiency
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Spell Efficiency. Tags: arch, passive, resonance. After you cast a prepared matrix, the next cast of that SAME matrix family before the end of your next regular turn costs 1 less RP, minimum 1. This cost reduction does not suppress Refrain, cannot reduce Overcast or additional feature costs and cannot combine with itself.

source.originalText: Spell Efficiency: Reduce the Resonance Point cost of frequently cast spells by 10%.

cards.name: Core Sync
cards.effect: Core Sync. Tags: hero, elementalist, passive, elemental. Rank-1 and rank-2 Wizard spells whose primary damage type matches your current Elemental Affinity cost 1 less RP, minimum 1. Once per long rest as a Bonus Action you may change your Elemental Affinity to Fire, Cold, Lightning or Earth; changing it does not alter currently active spell effects.

source.originalText: Core Sync: Spells of your chosen element cost 1 fewer RP at Tier 1–2 (minimum 1 RP); you may change your elemental affinity once per long rest

engineReferences.text: RITUAL CASTING is automatic at Wizard 2. A Wizard spell in your spellbook with the Ritual tag can be cast from the book without being prepared by increasing its casting time by at least 10 minutes. A ritual cast costs 0 RP unless that ritual explicitly lists a consumed RP cost, cannot be used during an encounter and cannot generate or vent Dissonance through ordinary casting strain.

MATRIX MASTERY MODIFICATIONS. After acquiring Matrix Mastery, each prepared ordinary spell matrix may carry at most one modification chosen during preparation. QUICK SUBSTITUTION: once per short rest, replace one matrix marked Quick Substitution with another spellbook spell of exactly the same rank using a 1-minute ritual instead of the normal 10-minute midday swap; the replacement loses the modification until the next long rest. COMPONENT ENHANCEMENT: when casting a damaging or healing matrix, spend 1 additional RP to add one extra die of the spell's primary damage or healing die to one roll; if the spell has no such die this modification has no effect. MATRIX LINKING: pair two different prepared matrix families during preparation; after legally casting one, the other costs 1 less RP, minimum 1, if cast before the end of your next regular turn, at most once per pair per round. STABILITY REINFORCEMENT: gain +2 on concentration saves caused by damage while maintaining that matrix. A matrix modification never creates another spell cast or proc event.

scope: Bounded source evidence, not an exhaustive proof of every cost-altering rule. Original full class files remain authoritative; distinguish RP reductions, non-RP waivers and actual spell classification.
